consistency.scope: Full native 24x24 covariance transformed into the common 15x15 navigation/bias marginal; not 24D NEES or NIS.
consistency.sampling: Every observer row at/after fusion time 117 s is retained, including repeated epochs and changed posteriors. NEES uses each row's fusion epoch; repeated observations are correlated. Startup rows are retained in the raw trace but outside the declared scoring windows.
consistency.conventions: Native attitude error is LEFT/NED (confirmed in fuse and symbolic derivation); position/velocity NED and bias rates FRD.
